# STYLE-12: No default argument for a single caller, or for a choice every caller should make

- A single caller can pass the value, and a choice with consequences is made by each caller, so a new one cannot inherit it by accident.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Code Style](../claude/CLAUDE.md#code-style). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
